mechanism: Match the small quarter-circle radius exposed on the left to the same material radius buried beside the rectangle on the right. The intended error cancels this 5 cm edge in the perimeter difference despite its change of boundary membership, producing 15 cm.
primary_unique_math_proof: The rectangle is 10 by5. Both large radii are10 and small radii5. Arc total in either arrangement is 2*(pi*10/2)+2*(pi*5/2)=15pi. The left exterior straight edges are 10+10+5+5=30; the right exterior straight edge is only the rectangle bottom10. Thus perimeters 15pi+30 and15pi+10 differ by20, uniquely E. The marked radius (-5,0)-(0,0) maps under a 90-degree rotation and translation to (30,-5)-(30,0), the same real small piece edge. The latter is an internal seam between the quarter circle and rectangle, not exterior.

marker_roles.role: Source: actual exposed 5 cm straight radius of the small left piece.
Receiver: the same 5 cm radius after the quarter-turn, now internal; source/receiver equal material edge but different perimeter membership.

human_semantics: Only two existing open straight radii are styled. All five piece contours, arcs, seams and joins stay fixed. The same physical radius can retain its ink in both arrangements, so physical-piece identity also remains consistent. No new cut, piece, dimensional equality symbol or fill is introduced.
